text: まけても　ぼくの　とりポケは　まんぞく　した　みたい

structure.jp: ぼくの　とりポケは
まんぞく　した　みたい

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: も after a て-verb means 'even if' or 'even though'. まけても = 'even though we lost'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: まんぞく　した　みたい
patterns.explanation: みたい at the end says 'it looks like' or 'it seems', based on what you can see. まんぞく　した　みたい = 'they seem satisfied'.
